answer: Persistent memory escrow: each agent identity must carry a continuously updated interaction ledger whose state is co-signed by every counterparty, forming a vine of mutual attestations. Like an ember, reputation decays unless rekindled by fresh trades, so idle clones lose standing. Cloning forces an attacker to fund separate ledgers with distinct co-signers, each requiring real counterparty work; scaling an ocean of sybils multiplies that labor linearly while honest agents amortize one ledger.
